info.title: StitchFlow API
info.description: The contract between the StitchFlow apps, the web admin panel and the API. Every operation names the permission action it needs (x-action); a destructive action is super admin only. Dates without a time are "YYYY-MM-DD"; instants are ISO-8601 UTC; money is rounded to the paisa. See HANDOVER.md.

UserRole.description: The five fixed roles. `worker` is shown as Operator.

timezone.description: IANA zone; "today" is this zone's date.

machineLimit.description: Most machines the unit may have. Set from the web admin panel only.

User.description: A person who can sign in. Never carries a password hash.

Member.description: A user's place in a property.

username.description: What they sign in with, with phone and email: the apps switch to this person by it.

staffId.description: The roster row this login is, if any.

modules.description: Gate every screen on this list.

number.description: The painted number; unique among live machines.

Staff.description: A person on the roster. Carries pay: supervisors never receive this shape.

payDaysPerMonth.description: Salary is divided by this for a day rate: 30 in the trade.

Person.description: A person without pay, for pickers and attendance — what a supervisor may see.

allowHalfDay.description: Whether a half day may be marked for them. Not pay.

Shift.description: One version of a shift. Editing opens a new version from a date.

lineageId.description: The shift all its versions belong to; equals id for a first version.

shiftId.description: A shift version in effect on workDate.

isStitchBased.description: Second machine: stitch-based rate, no attendance.

bonusAmount.description: The whole machine's bonus, split between its operators.

utilisation.description: Emb time over shift time, 0–1; null with no shift to measure.

OcrLine.description: One recognised line of a report photo, with its box in the image.

EntryDraft.description: What to save for one machine, date and shift. Upserts.

bonusAmount.description: A preview unless bonusIsManual: the server works it out.

scanId.description: The report scan that filled this slip.

reading.description: { field: { value, confidence, source } } as readSlip() produced it.

fromProduction.description: Credited by running a machine rather than marked by hand.

owedGoingIn.description: Given before the month ends, less what earlier paid payslips recovered.

SalaryPayment.description: A payslip: a snapshot, so a paid month stays what was paid.

periodStart.description: Inclusive; the first of the month.

breakdown.description: From the payslip when paid; worked out now otherwise.

PayslipInput.description: Mark a month paid. The server computes the snapshot; it takes no figures from the client.

toStitches.description: Exclusive; null for the open top band.

value.description: ₹ per 1,000 stitches, or a flat ₹, by the rule's kind.

shift.description: A name the unit typed; never translated.

DeletedItem.description: The facts, not sentences: the client words them in its language.

id.description: For attendance, the lowest id of the cleared month.

name.description: What the unit called it; never translated.

childCount.description: Rows that come back with it; for attendance, days.

modules.description: Selected modules. Each within the creator's own level and the role's ceiling.

temporaryPassword.description: Shown once. Must be changed at first sign-in.

refreshToken.description: Opaque. Rotates on every use. Keep it in the platform keystore.

next.description: At least 8 characters, not the demo password.

SettingsPatch.description: The shift arrangement and day start go through /shifts/scheme.

MachineAllowance.description: How many machines the unit may have, has, and has left.

used.description: Every machine not in the recycle bin, active or not.

left.description: At 0, adding or restoring a machine is refused: turn "Add machine" off.

message.description: English, for logs. Clients word `code` in the user's language.

totpCode.description: Six digits from the authenticator app, once two-factor sign-in is on.

secret.description: Base32, for typing into an authenticator app.

otpauthUrl.description: otpauth://totp/… — the same secret as a QR code's content.

code.description: Six digits from the authenticator app.

machineLimit.description: Lowering it below the machines the unit has removes nothing; it only stops adding.
